items.title: After Factory’s public spat with Khosla, Menlo proudly invests
items.summary: Days after Vinod Khosla called Factory a struggling also-ran, Menlo has shown up with a check and a glowing blog post.

items.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI unveils Beam, its first open-weight model, which it says rivals GLM-5.2 on reasoning with far less inference compute. Weights are due this month.
